name: nlyu-pm
description: Product discovery to PRD for product managers: research public sources on your own project or repository (BYOP) or on one of five example open-source products and choose an opportunity (/nlyu-pm:scout), build a clickable prototype (/nlyu-pm:prototype), write a repository-grounded PRD with an independent read-only review (/nlyu-pm:prd), and turn one of your own PM practices into a Claude skill (/nlyu-pm:create-skill).
